description:
Why won't house prices fall? Who's really paying for your "buy now, pay later"? Why did your insurance just jump?

Keeping Tabs turns the big money stories hitting your wallet (housing, debt, inflation, insurance, the stuff in the news that ends up on your bills) into short, funny stories you can actually follow, and retell.

Your guides: Tab (the curious one in the mustard hoodie) and Marge (the profit margin, who does not share).

Every number comes from a real source: government data, company filings, published research. Sources are linked in every video description, so you can check our math.

No investment advice. No stock tips. Just the receipts.

Subscribe if you've ever looked at a bill and thought: "wait, what?"
